title: Relative time expressions resolve against occurred_at, never against the wall clock at extraction
notes: Judgement call, and the important part of it is what is NOT asserted. v0.1 has no relative-time resolver, so the fixture does not assert 'next Tuesday' == 2026-09-22 (correct for the 2026-09-17 occurred_at) — asserting that would be asserting a feature that does not exist. What is mechanically checkable today is that the raw evidence survives verbatim, that valid_from is anchored to occurred_at rather than to extraction time, and that a later written-out date supersedes the relative one instead of being merged with it.

event.content: We cut the release next Tuesday, and the freeze start is in two weeks.
Correction: the freeze start is actually in three weeks.
